name: How much do small paint touch ups usually cost?

mainEntity.name: How much do small paint touch ups usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost depends on the number of spots, whether drywall spackling is needed, and whether you already have matching paint. For a standard visit covering minor scuffs, nail holes, and door dings across a couple of rooms, work is typically billed under basic handyman or small-project rates. If the existing paint needs to be custom-matched from a drywall sample or if full drywall patching and sanding are involved, labor time increases. Having labeled paint cans on hand keeps the total cost minimal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs reflect labor time, surface prep, and whether matching paint is on hand. Minor scuffs cost less, while drywall patching and color matching increase the total.
